summary: Prepare for PECB ISO/IEC 27034 Lead Application Security Implementer certification with five days of application security planning and implementation training.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, implement, or oversee application security under ISO/IEC 27034, including people who need to connect security requirements with software development work.
prerequisites: The PECB course page lists general knowledge of application security concepts and ISO/IEC 27034 as the main requirement for participating in this training course.
